# Round 1 factorial analysis

Within-project train-informed prospective comparison; earlier ARC and four-corner outcomes were exposed. F is the original production-score gold versus all non-gold mean within question, then equally averaged across questions. K and V switch full sequence; Q only R. The interventions are mixed states at one fixed receiver, not a unique natural causal decomposition.

I_Qi=Gi22−Gi21−Gi12+Gi11; J=I_Q2−I_Q1. Fraction signs use exact BF16 target logits, with no epsilon. Dynamic gap and per-candidate scores remain available in complete rows and ROUND1_FULL_RESULTS.json.

Each group table reports all 12 edges and interactions; the exact full distributions, fixed-wrong sensitivity, vector norms and subgroup details are bound in each summary JSON. All eight corners used full-vocabulary CUDA score replay and all four prior corners were checked bitwise against prior QKV. In-forward attribution rests on the audited frozen collector; deleted original natural whole shards were inherited from historical coverage, not reread.
